_meta.title: Greetopia Plant Knowledge Base
_meta.warning: Curated starter reference, not a validated agronomic prescription. The local profiles are not a verbatim copy of an external dataset. No species-specific numeric moisture thresholds are asserted. Validate local guidance and sensor calibration before automatic irrigation.

sources.name: OpenPlantDB
sources.use: External reference for general crop profile structure; its values vary by variety, region and microclimate. Full import is supported by the optional importer.

sources.name: FAO AQUASTAT: Crop water requirement
sources.use: Methodological context: crop water requirement depends on crop stage and climate, not species name alone.

sources.name: USDA PLANTS Database
sources.use: Taxonomic name verification reference; not used as irrigation thresholds.

sources.name: FAO AQUASTAT Irrigated Crop Calendars
sources.use: Context for crop calendars; availability and reliability vary by country and crop.

tomato.care_notes: Consider growth stage, root-zone moisture trend, drainage, temperature, and forecast conditions together. Avoid treating a single surface reading as proof that the root zone needs water.
tomato.monitoring_notes: Compare surface, mid-depth, and root-zone readings. Review trend and plant appearance; do not diagnose disease from sensor data alone.

basil.care_notes: Keep moisture reasonably consistent while avoiding waterlogged soil. Interpret readings in the context of pot size, substrate, light, and growth stage.
basil.monitoring_notes: Watch for sustained drying or waterlogging trends. Leaf appearance can provide context but is not a definitive diagnosis.

mint.care_notes: Mint generally prefers consistent moisture, but drainage and growing conditions matter. Avoid using a universal moisture percentage across different soil and sensor setups.
mint.monitoring_notes: Compare root-zone trends with recent watering and plant appearance.

lettuce.care_notes: Interpret moisture alongside growth stage, temperature, light, and substrate. Keep irrigation decisions conservative when sensor readings are stale.
lettuce.monitoring_notes: Use repeated root-zone readings and visual observations rather than one isolated reading.

cucumber.care_notes: Water demand varies with plant size, fruiting stage, temperature, container or bed, and substrate. Do not infer a fixed schedule from species alone.
cucumber.monitoring_notes: Consider root-zone moisture trends, weather, and growth stage together.

pepper.care_notes: Care depends on variety and growth stage. Use calibrated sensors and a locally verified moisture target for the actual growing medium.
pepper.monitoring_notes: Use root-zone readings and trends; avoid diagnosing nutrient or disease issues from moisture sensors alone.

eggplant.care_notes: Warm-season crop. Interpret root-zone moisture together with temperature, fruiting stage, drainage, and local growing conditions.
eggplant.monitoring_notes: Use calibrated sensor readings, timestamps, root-zone trends, and recent irrigation records. This note is not a numeric irrigation threshold.

beans.care_notes: Water needs vary by bean type and growth stage. Avoid waterlogging and use root-zone trends rather than a fixed schedule.
beans.monitoring_notes: Use calibrated sensor readings, timestamps, root-zone trends, and recent irrigation records. This note is not a numeric irrigation threshold.

spinach.care_notes: A cool-season leafy crop. Heat and growth stage affect water demand; assess root-zone moisture and local weather together.
spinach.monitoring_notes: Use calibrated sensor readings, timestamps, root-zone trends, and recent irrigation records. This note is not a numeric irrigation threshold.

coriander.care_notes: Moisture needs vary with temperature and whether the plant is grown for leaves or seed. Avoid assuming a universal sensor threshold.
coriander.monitoring_notes: Use calibrated sensor readings, timestamps, root-zone trends, and recent irrigation records. This note is not a numeric irrigation threshold.

parsley.care_notes: Keep an eye on consistent root-zone moisture and drainage. Container size, substrate, and light affect watering frequency.
parsley.monitoring_notes: Use calibrated sensor readings, timestamps, root-zone trends, and recent irrigation records. This note is not a numeric irrigation threshold.

rosemary.care_notes: Usually prefers well-drained media and can be harmed by persistent waterlogging. Confirm soil type before using automatic watering.
rosemary.monitoring_notes: Use calibrated sensor readings, timestamps, root-zone trends, and recent irrigation records. This note is not a numeric irrigation threshold.

thyme.care_notes: Often prefers good drainage and tolerates some drying between waterings, but local conditions and growing medium matter.
thyme.monitoring_notes: Use calibrated sensor readings, timestamps, root-zone trends, and recent irrigation records. This note is not a numeric irrigation threshold.

oregano.care_notes: Typically prefers drainage and should not be kept continuously waterlogged. Use a calibrated root-zone sensor.
oregano.monitoring_notes: Use calibrated sensor readings, timestamps, root-zone trends, and recent irrigation records. This note is not a numeric irrigation threshold.

strawberry.care_notes: Moisture should be interpreted alongside fruiting stage, weather, container or bed, and drainage.
strawberry.monitoring_notes: Use calibrated sensor readings, timestamps, root-zone trends, and recent irrigation records. This note is not a numeric irrigation threshold.

carrot.care_notes: Root development is affected by soil structure and moisture consistency. Use depth-appropriate readings and avoid waterlogging.
carrot.monitoring_notes: Use calibrated sensor readings, timestamps, root-zone trends, and recent irrigation records. This note is not a numeric irrigation threshold.

radish.care_notes: Fast-growing radishes can respond to uneven moisture; consider growth stage, temperature, and substrate.
radish.monitoring_notes: Use calibrated sensor readings, timestamps, root-zone trends, and recent irrigation records. This note is not a numeric irrigation threshold.

potato.care_notes: Water demand changes by growth stage. Avoid relying on leaf appearance alone or applying a universal soil-moisture percentage.
potato.monitoring_notes: Use calibrated sensor readings, timestamps, root-zone trends, and recent irrigation records. This note is not a numeric irrigation threshold.

onion.care_notes: Water demand changes during development and bulb formation. Interpret moisture with soil type and growth stage.
onion.monitoring_notes: Use calibrated sensor readings, timestamps, root-zone trends, and recent irrigation records. This note is not a numeric irrigation threshold.

garlic.care_notes: Water requirements depend on growth stage and soil drainage. Keep records of moisture trends and irrigation events.
garlic.monitoring_notes: Use calibrated sensor readings, timestamps, root-zone trends, and recent irrigation records. This note is not a numeric irrigation threshold.

zucchini.care_notes: Water demand changes with plant size, flowering, fruiting, and heat. Use root-zone trends and local weather.
zucchini.monitoring_notes: Use calibrated sensor readings, timestamps, root-zone trends, and recent irrigation records. This note is not a numeric irrigation threshold.

okra.care_notes: Warm-season crop; water demand varies with temperature, plant size, and fruiting. Confirm targets for the local soil and sensor.
okra.monitoring_notes: Use calibrated sensor readings, timestamps, root-zone trends, and recent irrigation records. This note is not a numeric irrigation threshold.

watermelon.care_notes: Water demand varies by growth stage and climate. Avoid using image appearance as a soil-moisture measurement.
watermelon.monitoring_notes: Use calibrated sensor readings, timestamps, root-zone trends, and recent irrigation records. This note is not a numeric irrigation threshold.

melon.care_notes: Water needs vary by variety, stage, and weather. Monitor root-zone trends and drainage.
melon.monitoring_notes: Use calibrated sensor readings, timestamps, root-zone trends, and recent irrigation records. This note is not a numeric irrigation threshold.

corn.care_notes: Water demand can be sensitive during rapid growth and reproductive stages. Local crop guidance is needed for exact irrigation targets.
corn.monitoring_notes: Use calibrated sensor readings, timestamps, root-zone trends, and recent irrigation records. This note is not a numeric irrigation threshold.

sunflower.care_notes: Water demand depends on growth stage, root depth, and soil. Treat generic profile guidance as a starting point only.
sunflower.monitoring_notes: Use calibrated sensor readings, timestamps, root-zone trends, and recent irrigation records. This note is not a numeric irrigation threshold.

broccoli.care_notes: Cool-season crop; temperature and growth stage influence demand. Monitor root-zone moisture and drainage.
broccoli.monitoring_notes: Use calibrated sensor readings, timestamps, root-zone trends, and recent irrigation records. This note is not a numeric irrigation threshold.

cauliflower.care_notes: Water needs depend on growth stage and temperature. Avoid overwatering in poorly drained growing media.
cauliflower.monitoring_notes: Use calibrated sensor readings, timestamps, root-zone trends, and recent irrigation records. This note is not a numeric irrigation threshold.

cabbage.care_notes: Moisture consistency can matter during head development; interpret sensor values in context of substrate and plant stage.
cabbage.monitoring_notes: Use calibrated sensor readings, timestamps, root-zone trends, and recent irrigation records. This note is not a numeric irrigation threshold.

green_peas.care_notes: Water needs depend on season and growth stage. Avoid prolonged waterlogging and review local crop advice.
green_peas.monitoring_notes: Use calibrated sensor readings, timestamps, root-zone trends, and recent irrigation records. This note is not a numeric irrigation threshold.

jasmine.care_notes: Care varies by species and growing conditions. Confirm exact species before relying on any species-specific care assumptions.
jasmine.monitoring_notes: Use calibrated sensor readings, timestamps, root-zone trends, and recent irrigation records. This note is not a numeric irrigation threshold.

rose.care_notes: Watering varies by variety, pot or bed, climate, and growth stage. Use root-zone readings and visual observations together.
rose.monitoring_notes: Use calibrated sensor readings, timestamps, root-zone trends, and recent irrigation records. This note is not a numeric irrigation threshold.

marigold.care_notes: Water needs vary by container, soil, and weather. Let drainage and repeated readings guide decisions.
marigold.monitoring_notes: Use calibrated sensor readings, timestamps, root-zone trends, and recent irrigation records. This note is not a numeric irrigation threshold.

aloe_vera.care_notes: Succulent; persistent wet soil can be harmful. Confirm substrate drainage and keep automatic irrigation conservative.
aloe_vera.monitoring_notes: Use calibrated sensor readings, timestamps, root-zone trends, and recent irrigation records. This note is not a numeric irrigation threshold.

citrus.care_notes: Water demand varies substantially with species, rootstock, container, season, and fruiting. Seek locally appropriate crop guidance.
citrus.monitoring_notes: Use calibrated sensor readings, timestamps, root-zone trends, and recent irrigation records. This note is not a numeric irrigation threshold.

grape.care_notes: Water needs depend on vine age, soil, climate, and production goals. Avoid generic fixed watering schedules.
grape.monitoring_notes: Use calibrated sensor readings, timestamps, root-zone trends, and recent irrigation records. This note is not a numeric irrigation threshold.
